lines.en: “Dokja-ajusshi?”
Watching the Yoo Joonghyuks fighting fiercely in the distance, I hesitated.
[Your incarnation body is currently unstable!]
Running over in my present condition could not possibly help.
Besides, looking closely, I saw that the combatants were [999] and the ‘Secretive Plotter.’ I did not know why, but [999] seemed to have decided to take our side.
I clenched my fist.
「Kim Dokja thought. There is only one way.」
[Omniscient Reader’s Viewpoint].
Just as in the fight with Nirvana, and in the fight with Poseidon……
―Youngest, why do you hesitate?
It was the Great Sage, Heaven’s Equal. Even while continuing his fierce battle in the sky, he seemed to have sensed my feelings.
I murmured in a voice barely loud enough to hear.
“……I’m a little afraid of reading now.”
Perhaps it had begun after my confrontation with Yoo Joonghyuk on ‘Reincarnation Island.’
More recently, perhaps it had begun right after I heard [999]’s words.
「“Do you still think you can understand someone through a few lines of writing?”」
Until now, I had been the ‘reader’ of all these stories.
But how long was it all right for me to remain that sort of reader?
―I see. You have the power to read others.
He had guessed what my ability was.
Since he had spent so long in my channel as the ‘Prisoner of the Golden Headband,’ noticing that much could hardly have been difficult.
―I too once wanted to understand someone.
I felt the Great Sage’s gaze reach Yoo Sangah. More precisely, not Yoo Sangah, but her ‘incarnation body.’ He was looking at that body’s ‘previous owner.’
―Even now, I do not understand why Sanzang drove me away twice.
In the original 『Journey to the West』, Sun Wukong was dismissed twice.

―But I never properly confronted Sanzang about it. It must have been my petty pride. I only thought about it, again and again, alone. Why had he done that then? Why had he made that choice? Why had he been so stubborn? What had I done wrong, and where had the problem begun? Even after the journey ended, those questions kept circling inside me.
It was the first time I had heard such a story.
Even the Great Sage, Heaven’s Equal, had his own unanswered questions.
―And when I finally found the courage, the opportunity was already gone.
The Great Sage’s voice was faintly dejected.
Knowing little of what happened after 『Journey to the West』, I could not fathom his sorrow.
What was certain was that Yoo Sangah had reincarnated in ‘Sanzang’s’ incarnation body. And that the real ‘Sanzang’ was no longer in this world.
―To find the answer to that question, I kept taking part in 「Journey to the West Remake」. I hoped someone else might tell me what I had not known, what I had not been able to read.
Only then did I think I understood why the Great Sage had joined this scenario event.
Suddenly, I wondered. Had he found his answer?
―I found no answer. Only…… a little comfort.
The Great Sage’s gaze was on Shin Yoosung. Fending off the barrage of attacks from <Emperor>, he spoke.
―That comfort taught me something.
[The Giant Story ‘Journey to the West’ continues its story.]

―There may be things we will never understand. We may never reach them, and every effort may come to nothing. But even knowing it is impossible, we must read Stories. That is what it means to become a star in this sky and exist as a ‘constellation.’
The Great Sage did not understand Sanzang. And perhaps he never would.
Even so, he did not give up.
―So you too must read.
‘But alone, I……’
―Why do you think you are alone?
At his words, I raised my head without thinking.
―Perhaps not as you do, but everyone reads one another. So do not stop reading either.
Perhaps it was not precise advice.
But I too felt something. As if tiny feathers were accumulating. I thought that perhaps this was the comfort the Great Sage had found while watching our story.
“Yoo Sangah-ssi.”
At my words, Yoo Sangah turned as though she had been waiting.
“Will you be all right?”
“Yes. But, if possible, gently―”
Nodding, Yoo Sangah recited the Headband-Tightening Incantation at me.
My body pitched forward as if a fuse had blown. In that instant, my consciousness slipped free and headed exactly where it needed to go.
[Omniscient Reader’s Viewpoint ‘Stage 3’ activates!]
[Your understanding of this person is currently very high!]
[‘First-Person Protagonist’s Viewpoint’ activates!]
As my vision slowly settled into place, formidable power began overflowing through my whole body. Yoo Joonghyuk’s power.
Soon, I saw the enemy before us. A being looking down on us, surrounded by an aura of tremendous Status.
The Secretive Plotter.
The Great Sage was right.
That being could never be defeated alone.
「Let’s go.」
A transcendent’s Status surging throughout my body.
I added all the Status I possessed to Yoo Joonghyuk’s.
[The Status of a transcendent encounters the Status of a demon king!]
The power I had gained surged as it meshed with Yoo Joonghyuk’s. Vitality flowed through every blood vessel, as though my body had undergone a complete transformation.
Yoo Joonghyuk slowly opened his eyes, golden light shining from them, and spoke.
‘You’re late.’
Instead of getting angry or rebuking me, Yoo Joonghyuk merely said that.
Even though he must have known I had been playing Sun Wukong……
「I’m sorry.」
‘Save the pointless words for later. Defeating him comes first now.’
Kuwaaaaaah!

With a casual swing of his [Splitting the Sky Sword], the ‘Secretive Plotter’ cleaved the Tongtian River, and we narrowly evaded the attack. Constellations and incarnations who happened to be nearby were swept away together, turning into screams. Its attack power was absurd.
【A futile effort. Even if you regain your memories, you cannot defeat me. Because, in the end, you originated from me.】
「What is he talking about?」
Running over the river, Yoo Joonghyuk answered irritably.
‘According to him, I am not the Yoo Joonghyuk of the third round.’
「What? Then?」
I asked without thinking, but in truth a jumble of hypotheses was already engulfing my mind. Perhaps these doubts had been accumulating for a very long time.
「‘The Yoo Joonghyuk of the third round couldn’t possibly know this.’」
Even in the [Green Zone] scenario.
「‘……No matter how I look at it, he’s growing too quickly.’」
……And in the [Theatre Dungeon].
The doubts that had lingered at the back of my mind whenever I checked Yoo Joonghyuk’s [Character List] were multiplying, one leading to another.
My conversation with [999] flashed through my mind too.
「“This worldline’s Yoo Joonghyuk said he was on his ‘third turn’. So this is the third turn.”」
「“You’re naive, believing information like that at face value.”」
When I came to my senses, I had already activated [Character List].
[There is too much information about this character. ‘Character List’ converts to ‘Summary List.’]
[Only fields arbitrarily selected for the user’s convenience will be displayed.]
<Character Summary List>
Character: Yoo Joonghyuk
Exclusive Attributes: Regressor <3rd Round> (Myth), Ruler of Amusement (Legendary)……
The third round. He was definitely in the third round.
Then what on earth did their words mean……
「Kim Dok ja doyou really not know?」
The pages of my memories were turning.
Memories I had tried not to recall.
「“Does that ‘world’ you showed me truly exist?”」
「[This person is not a ‘character.’]」
‘Get a grip, Kim Dokja!’
Yoo Joonghyuk’s shout jolted me back to my senses. This was no time to think about anything else.
The ‘Secretive Plotter’ hovered in the air, his Status growing stronger and stronger.
【It seems you still have not properly recalled your memories.】
“……I won’t lose so easily this time.”

As though resisting that Status, Yoo Joonghyuk raised his own power. He pushed the footwork of [Red Phoenix Shunpo] and the power of [Breaking the Sky Swordsmanship] to their limits. Breaking the Sky Sword Thunder covered the [Black Heavenly Demon Sword].
Yoo Joonghyuk had fought the same way once before. And lost.
But this time, that was not all.
[Bookmark No. 5 is activated!]
[Exclusive skill ‘Electrification (電人化) Lv.23(+13)’ has been activated.]
[Exclusive skill ‘Way of the Wind Lv.18(+8)’ activates!]
[‘Demon King Transformation’ activates!]

The power of [Way of the Wind] infused Yoo Joonghyuk’s [Red Phoenix Shunpo], the lightning of [Electrification] infused [Breaking the Sky Sword Thunder], and the power of a ‘demon king’ was added to that of a ‘transcendent.’
Twofold, threefold, fourfold…… Swelling in an instant, Yoo Joonghyuk’s Status spread menacingly throughout the area around the Tongtian River.
Tzzzzzt!

As sparks flew, we charged at the ‘Secretive Plotter.’ [Electrification] and [Breaking the Sky Sword Thunder] within the [Black Heavenly Demon Sword]. When Kyrgios’s and the Breaking the Sky Sword Saint’s secret arts shone together, a tremendous storm of aura swept in.
Kuwaaaaaaah!
It was enough power to cleave mountains and melt the sea.

Yet before that power, the ‘Secretive Plotter’ remained calm. Two swords colliding with a scraping crash. Sharing every sensation with Yoo Joonghyuk, I felt pain as though my hands were being torn apart.
We used both hands. He used one. Even so
【How unfortunate, Yoo Joonghyuk.】
We could not cut down the ‘Secretive Plotter.’
Tsst, tssst.
The sparks around him said he was not at full power. Yet how could the gap in combat strength still be so great?
[The Story ‘Hell of Eternity’ continues its story.]
His stage was covering our surroundings. A hell of 1,863 regressions. ‘Outer Gods’ groaning in fire pits, and the corpses of stars.
【To forget even yourself as the price of escaping a closed universe and dreaming of a new story. Was that truly the world you wanted?】
A voice like an evil spirit’s came from the hellscape.
I was confused. I felt I understood his words, yet found them hard to accept.
A Yoo Joonghyuk who had escaped a closed universe and dreamed of a new story.
As far as I knew, there was only one such Yoo Joonghyuk.
If that was true.
If the Yoo Joonghyuk I knew was truly that ‘Yoo Joonghyuk.’
[The ‘Fourth Wall’ grows thicker.]
‘Kim Dokja, you need to come up with a clever plan.’
Yoo Joonghyuk shouted.
‘Use the Story you used last time.’
I knew which ‘last time’ he meant.
「Hell of Eternity」.
The Story we had used while fighting Poseidon.
Then, we had borrowed the memories of Yoo Joonghyuk’s 362nd round to kill Theseus.
I groaned as I looked at the dark Story flowing beneath the ‘Secretive Plotter.’
「Honestly, I don’t know whether we could win even with that.」
The furthest round I had read with all my strength was only the 362nd. I would do better now than then, but I had no idea whether it would be enough to defeat the being before us.
「And……」
That was not all that made me hesitate.
If I succeeded in borrowing the power of Yoo Joonghyuk from the 362nd round or later, Yoo Joonghyuk would read those memories with me.
As constellations read incarnations’ Stories, I had read Yoo Joonghyuk’s ‘Ways of Survival.’
If I used 「Hell of Eternity」 here, Yoo Joonghyuk would experience my interpretation, stained by misunderstandings, with me.
The ‘Ways of Survival’ I had read to survive. A history I remembered however I pleased.
In that history, Yoo Joonghyuk was only a one-sided distortion or exaggeration, a problematic figure or an idolized one.
「……Damn it.」
Even so, I had to commit that violence.
[The Story ‘Hell of Eternity’ begins its story!]
In profound helplessness, I turn the page. It is the same before the apocalypse and after it. All I can ever do is turn the pages of a book.
Countless rounds of Yoo Joonghyuk’s life passed before me.
The 3rd, 4th, 5th rounds…… the 41st…… the 182nd……
Memories flowed past.
Countless Yoo Joonghyuks were watching us.
The 362nd round…… the 598th…… the 724th……
[Your ‘Reading Comprehension’ advances toward a new possibility!]
[Pages you could not comprehend unfold!]
The 862nd round…… the 999th……
Blood welled up from deep inside me. My head hurt as though it would split.
[999]. A round I had loved.
Yoo Joonghyuk’s dialogue slowly began to dwindle. This was my limit.
[You have reached the highest round you can comprehend.]
[The highest round of ‘Yoo Joonghyuk’ you can comprehend is the ‘999th round.’]
A message appeared like a grade on a book report. I could not lift my head.
Was reading really so shameful, so sinful?
That was when Yoo Joonghyuk spoke.
‘However you read it, I am the one who judges. So keep reading.’
Covered in wounds, he spoke while fending off attacks from the ‘Secretive Plotter.’
‘What I hear and what I remember are my choice. I decide who I am too.’
In a voice I knew well, he told a story I did not know.
‘You are not reading alone.’
The moment I heard that, something awoke within me.
It was not a memory of Ways of Survival. It was a conversation with my mother, long ago.
「“Why would I read a story again when I already know all of it?”」
Some stories remain the same even when reread. Because the reader does not change, neither does the story.
My mother had answered my question like this.
「“Shall we read it together, then?”」
Reading together.
[Your ‘Reading Comprehension’ improves dramatically!]
In my increasingly chaotic mind, pages I had been unable to turn alone were turning.
The 1146th round…… the 1398th…… the 1561st…… the 1733rd……
The people I had met in this world were turning those pages with me.
Some things I still could not understand, and others finally made sense.
And there were sentences I felt I would never understand.
I heard the ‘Secretive Plotter’ shout something.
My consciousness kept fading. Like someone fighting sleep, I kept turning page after page. Bleeding profusely, enduring tremendous sparks.
I still do not understand Yoo Joonghyuk well.
「“You can only return to that world if I die, can’t you?”」
「“If you stay here, you cannot save that world.”」
But if this misunderstanding I had built up over more than ten years could, by some miracle, lead to even the faintest understanding.
「“I’ve grown curious about that world’s ■■.”」
I would be able to read again.
[The highest round of ‘Yoo Joonghyuk’ you can comprehend is the ‘1863rd round.’]
The incoming Status of the ‘Secretive Plotter’ touched the [Black Heavenly Demon Sword] and scattered.
I blinked blankly. [Character List] was changing, as if overlaid letters were peeling away. The number 3 peeled off, and a new number was being inscribed in its place.
On a dazzling blank sheet, a page I had never read was unfolding.
<Character Summary List>
Character: Yoo Joonghyuk
Exclusive Attributes: Regressor <1864th Round> (Myth)……
It was an entirely new story.
The 1864th round.
This was not the third round, but the worldline of the 1864th round.
The moment I saw the Attributes Window, a realization too great to absorb at once overwhelmed me.
「……This ‘Yoo Joonghyuk’ is the ‘Yoo Joonghyuk’ who disappeared from the 1863rd round?」
「How could that possibly happen?」
「But hadn’t that Yoo Joonghyuk broken free of being a [character]?」
「The Yoo Joonghyuk of the 1863rd round could escape being a character because the third round existed. But if he was the third round’s Yoo Joonghyuk from the start, what does that……」
As countless questions passed through my mind, the last thing I recalled was my conversation with tls123.
「I’m thinking of sending you a special gift as a token of my thanks, dear reader.」
Perhaps the ‘gift’ the author had mentioned then was……
Kwakwakwakwakwa!
The overflowing power of Stories. The hellscape’s panorama was changing. The world screamed, and grief-stricken Outer Gods howled.
On that stage of despair was a tiny ray of light, threadlike yet unmistakable. It was the tip of the [Black Heavenly Demon Sword].
【Have you recovered your memories?】
The ‘Secretive Plotter’ asked. But Yoo Joonghyuk did not answer. I too knew why he did not answer. Explosive memories were tearing through Yoo Joonghyuk’s mind.
My reading was not perfect.
However hard I had read, even with Yoo Joonghyuk reading alongside me, fully restoring the ‘Yoo Joonghyuk of the 1863rd round’ was physically impossible.
As Yoo Joonghyuk staggered, fragments of memories flowed through his mind.
「“Eat dirt, Yoo Joonghyuk.”」
「“Happy memories! Happy memories!”」
「“Yoo Joonghyuk, sit.”」
“You bastard……”
「This is no time to think about that, idiot!」
I hurriedly roused Yoo Joonghyuk. The [Splitting the Sky Sword], carrying the hellscape’s Status, was rushing toward us right before our eyes.
With a scraping crash, the two swords collided once more.
It was still a heavy blow.
But not as heavy as before.
【……I wanted to fight you.】

For the first time, the eyes of the ‘Secretive Plotter,’ calm throughout, began to show a glimmer of emotion. The Yoo Joonghyuk who had lived the ‘original’ I read and finally seen its end—the ‘Secretive Plotter’—was speaking.
【You disappeared ‘beyond’ without a word.】
I could not understand what he meant. Yoo Joonghyuk seemed no more able to understand it.
My hurried reading was unstable, leaving many holes in Yoo Joonghyuk’s memories.
Yoo Joonghyuk spoke through clenched teeth.
“I’ll have to teach you to speak so people can understand.”
[The Giant Story ‘Demon Realm’s Spring’ begins its story!]
[The Giant Story ‘Torch That Swallowed the Myth’ begins its story!]
[The Story ‘Hell of Eternity’ continues its story!]

Our Stories entered the [Black Heavenly Demon Sword] together. The flurry of blows that followed collided with the [Splitting the Sky Sword] once again. At the moment the two hellscapes clashed, a universe opened between them.
It was a big bang of memories.
[Two excessively similar beings collide.]
[‘Disconnected Film Theory’ activates!]
The instant I saw the universe’s vista, I understood what was about to happen.
This was [Disconnected Film Theory].
Something similar had happened when the two Shin Yoosungs from different worldlines met.
「【……A new worldline?】」
Memories called forth by the collision of two Yoo Joonghyuks, endlessly alike yet walking utterly opposite paths.
「【There cannot be a worldline like this.】」
They were the memories of the ‘Secretive Plotter.’
What had happened the day the ‘Secretive Plotter’ discovered this third round.
【Interesting. This is the third round……?】

The Secretive Plotter could not look away from the third round’s story unfolding before him. Someone he did not know was leading the story alongside his third-round self. He could not understand how this was possible.
【Success will be impossible anyway.】

Some things followed methods he knew, and some followed methods even he had never considered. Sometimes they seemed reckless; sometimes they were lucky. A Story he had never seen. As though drawn in, the Secretive Plotter peered into that worldline’s Story.
How long had he been watching their Story like that?
The ‘Secretive Plotter’ realized he had become exactly like the constellations he hated so much.
The Yoo Joonghyuks he had absorbed spoke.
―Have you forgotten, Great Plotter?
―We want ‘death.’
―That round’s success will be impossible anyway.
Death. It was the wish of every Yoo Joonghyuk cursed with regression.
The ‘Secretive Plotter’ existed only to carry out that mission.
―Killing the ‘Oldest Dream’ is impossible.
―As long as we live, we will regress again.
―Even if death is impossible, what if we could come endlessly close to it?
That was why he had sent Han Sooyoung’s avatar to the 1863rd round.
To use the irregular he had found in the third round to achieve death.
He planned to seal every Yoo Joonghyuk using [Disconnected Film Theory]. To become one with the Yoo Joonghyuk of the 1863rd round and fall into endless, eternal sleep.
But as he neared the completion of that plan, he had a change of heart.
「“I am a being headed toward the ‘Final Chapter (終章).’”」
Because of a constellation who had found his own ■■.
Final Chapter. The name of the ■■ he had wanted so desperately, yet never obtained.
[‘Yoo Joonghyuk’ of the 41st round is shocked.]
[‘Yoo Joonghyuk’ of the 416th round is shocked.]
[‘Yoo Joonghyuk’ of the 967th round is shocked.]
[‘Yoo Joonghyuk’ of the 1472nd round is shocked.]
Every round’s Yoo Joonghyuk within him had seen that sight too.
Some Yoo Joonghyuks marveled, some Yoo Joonghyuks despaired. And some Yoo Joonghyuks were angry.
The ‘Secretive Plotter’ was one of those who were angry.
【……There cannot be another Final Chapter.】
His world had already ended. The ‘Conclusion’ he had reached through the trial and error of 1,863 rounds. He had lost everything and seen the scenarios’ end. Reached the Wall.
He had not been wrong. He wanted that acknowledged.
【Suppose you reach the end of everything and save the world in your own way. Then what do you intend to do about the ‘other worlds’?】
【What becomes of all those worlds you could not save?】
That was why the ‘Secretive Plotter’ had sent Kim Dokja to the 1863rd round.
Made him see the end of the story there.
This was the true ‘original.’
The end I had chosen for the world, which nothing could change.
「“I’ll end your story for you.”」
But Kim Dokja
「“I won’t return to the third round. I’ll stay here and see the ending with the people of this place.”」
had changed it.
Tzzzzzzzt!
The attempt to seal Yoo Joonghyuk failed, and the story veered from its predetermined course.
[The Yoo Joonghyuk of the 1863rd round refuses to agree with you.]
「“I want to live.”」
The Yoo Joonghyuk who should have been sealed chose ‘Regression’ and went to a new world.

After collecting the dead Yoo Joonghyuk’s memories, the ‘Secretive Plotter’ hurried after the one who had left. Through the dazzling starlight of the worldlines, he pursued the white-coated Yoo Joonghyuk, who scattered his memories as he went.
Yoo Joonghyuk, casting off the guise of a [character] and heading for an entirely new world.
【Stop! You cannot go on!】
Only the ‘Secretive Plotter’ knew this world’s ending.
The 1863rd round was the ‘end of this entire story.’ After this.
「I want to see ‘that world.’」
【Come back. This is where you belong! You―】

The Secretive Plotter shouted. Even if the ‘Oldest Dream’ permitted that regression, Yoo Joonghyuk would only repeat the nightmare. Playing the scenarios from the beginning, having even lost his memories……
「He clearly said it. That it was a universe that existed.」
[The ‘Oldest Dream’ is curious about that story.]
Yoo Joonghyuk was reaching out. Imagining. A world very far away. A world that had not existed in the universe of ‘Ways of Survival.’
By a hair’s breadth, the ‘Secretive Plotter’ caught Yoo Joonghyuk’s soul body. But all he held was the white coat. Yoo Joonghyuk’s body was already gone.
The ‘Secretive Plotter’ muttered hollowly.
【You fool……】
Having lost his memories, Yoo Joonghyuk succeeded in regressing.
A futile story whose beginning and end were already fixed.
He would repeat an eternity of nightmares there again.
The ‘Secretive Plotter’ began searching the worldlines.

He wanted to see the worldline that arrogant fellow had vanished into at the cost of even his memories. He felt he could only be satisfied after seeing him utterly broken, continuing the scenarios in regret.
And the ‘Secretive Plotter’ found that worldline. Astonishingly, it was a worldline he already knew.
【……This cannot be.】
Only then was everything becoming clear.
Why an unknown worldline had suddenly appeared.
Why an entirely different worldline existed where the third round should have been.
A ‘worldline atop the Wall,’ made by sacrificing every round he had lived.
[The ‘Oldest Dream’ dreams the final dream.]
An impossible worldline, created by the result interfering with the cause.
His universe was shaking.
With an explosion, Yoo Joonghyuk and the ‘Secretive Plotter’ broke apart. Readjusting our grip on the [Black Heavenly Demon Sword], we glared at the enemy before us.
The ‘Secretive Plotter’ spoke.
【……Now you understand. It was a universe that should not exist.】
Now I could understand what the Secretive Plotter meant.
Why this worldline had been born. Why all this was happening. I could understand a little.
The ‘beyond’ the Yoo Joonghyuk of the 1863rd round had chosen when he regressed.
It was this very round in which we lived.
【How cruel. Barely freed from being a nightmare’s puppet, what you chose was to become a puppet again.】
A tone steeped in sorrow. The voice of the ‘Secretive Plotter’ held resentment of a depth I could not fathom.
【Read the same book hundreds of times, and your interpretation may change. But the sentences do not. It has already ended. It cannot be undone.】
The ‘Secretive Plotter’ was inscribing a path in the air with his [Splitting the Sky Sword].
A path carrying the weight of 1,863 rounds.
Someone who had once been Yoo Joonghyuk, and now lived as the ‘Secretive Plotter.’
A being who dreamed of the ‘death’ of every Yoo Joonghyuk in the world.
He was speaking.
【You were able to survive because of the life I lived.】
That being was wielding his own history.
【You should have died on the subway, in the Theatre Dungeon. You should have been killed by Nirvana, and you should have died in the Dark Castle.】
He was right.

【You should have died in the Demon Realm. You should have died in ‘Gigantomachia,’ and you should have died in the ‘Great War of Saints and Demons,’ in ‘Journey to the West,’ dozens of times, hundreds of times.】
Without his life, without his failures.
We could not have survived this far.
【Why did you survive?】
He was asking us.
【Why is it you, and not me?】
I recalled my first visit to the 1863rd round.
When I first saw its Yoo Joonghyuk, I had thought he was the ‘Yoo Joonghyuk of the original’ I knew.
The protagonist who had shared my childhood and sustained my life.
But he was not.

The Yoo Joonghyuk who had sustained me had finished that story long ago. He had reached the 1863rd round’s ending, seen the world’s end, and wandered the terrible abyss of worldlines. For thousands of years, perhaps tens of thousands.
I did not know how many years he had spent that way. What was certain was that he had survived until now, remembered all that time,
and was now hostile to me.
【You have no right to see ■■.】
That was true.
I had only made it through the scenarios until now because the life of the ‘Secretive Plotter’ had come first.
The Status of the ‘Secretive Plotter’ was growing stronger. The ‘Outer Gods’ who had been watching nearby knelt in unison.
【Oooooooooh……】
The billowing aura is engulfing the [Splitting the Sky Sword].
That was the power he had gained through 1,863 rounds and his journeys through the worldlines afterward.
[The Giant Story ‘Lonely Pilgrim of Destruction’ begins its story.]
Countless ‘Yoo Joonghyuks’ within him looked at me.
[‘Yoo Joonghyuk’ of the 41st round is watching you.]
[‘Yoo Joonghyuk’ of the 362nd round is watching you.]
[‘Yoo Joonghyuk’ of the 666th round is watching you.]
[‘Yoo Joonghyuk’ of the 999th round is watching you.]
The history and sins they had accumulated were there.
A sin value whose full extent even Jophiel’s [Eye of Sin] could not discern.
He was a being the <Star Stream> defined as ‘fear.’ Beyond the category of evil, he had been declared incomprehensible (不可解) by this world. The king of Outer Gods.
But at his core, he was neither evil nor fear.
The reason the <Star Stream> had no choice but to reject him was that his justice was too unyielding.
「“I will destroy the Star Stream.”」
The <Star Stream> does not like justice without the slightest flexibility.
Justice must bend, yield, and sometimes collapse. But the justice of the ‘Secretive Plotter’ did not.
That was how he had come this far, and ultimately become the ‘Secretive Plotter.’
「“Without fail, I will destroy the being who began this story—with my own hands.”」
That was the ‘destruction’ of this world he wanted.
The ‘end of regression’ every Yoo Joonghyuk desired.
[The constellation ‘Secretive Plotter’ looks at you.]
The ‘Secretive Plotter’ was entirely justified.
More than anyone…… he had the right to see the end of all these stories.
Far more than someone like me, who had done nothing but read ‘Ways of Survival’―
‘Don’t get any strange ideas. And don’t presume to empathize with him.’
Yoo Joonghyuk was speaking.
‘Will you yield to someone else after coming this far? Did you build your Stories solely by copying his life?’
I could not answer.
‘Accepting his words means denying the time of the other companions who fought beside you.’

It was true that I had initially relied on ‘Ways of Survival’ to avoid danger. But things were different after that. Events that had never happened in the original occurred, and dangers absent from the original appeared. I had overcome those dangers with my companions.
As Stories accumulated, the divergence from ‘Ways of Survival’ grew, and at some point I stopped consulting the original. That was also why I had never read the final version.
By now, this world was no longer the world of ‘Ways of Survival’ that the ‘Secretive Plotter’ had lived in.
